claims: The TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team represents Texas Christian University.
Texas Christian University is in Fort Worth, Texas.
The TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team competes in the Big 12 Conference.
Jamie Dixon is the head coach of the TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team.
Jamie Dixon is in his 10th season as of 2026.
The TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team plays home games at the Ed & Rae Schollmaier Arena.
Ed & Rae Schollmaier Arena is in Fort Worth, Texas.
The TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team has appeared 12 times in the NCAA Tournament in school history.
The 2026 NCAA Tournament marked TCU's 12th NCAA Tournament appearance.
Xavier Edmonds and David Punch are All-Big 12 Conference frontcourt.
In the 2025-26 season, the TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team finished 6th in the Big 12.
In the 2025-26 season, the TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team faced all four No. 1 seeds in the 2026 tournament
